options.text: Decreases for both conductors and semiconductors
Increases for conductors but decreases for semiconductors
Decreases for conductors but increases for semiconductors
Increases for both conductors and semiconductors

explanation:
As the temperature increases the resistivity of the conductor increases hence the electrical resistance 
increases. However for semiconductor the resistivity decreases with the temperature. Hence electrical 
resistance of semiconductor decreases.
